描述_EN: this plate is a good example of the ware. although cizhou wares were made in a number of kilns in different regions, they are linked by shared design characteristics. its stoneware body is decorated with a white slip (a diluted white clay which gives a consistent ground colour) over the surface, and the floral design carved through this slip to form a contrasting curvilinear design. this dish is an example of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the song dynasty (960-1279).
描述_ZN: 此盘是该器皿的一个很好的例子。 虽然慈溪器皿是在不同地区的一些窑场生产的，但它们因共同的设计特点而联系在一起。 它的石器主体表面用白滑（一种稀释的白泥，使地面颜色一致）进行装饰，并通过这种滑液雕刻出花卉图案，形成一种对比强烈的曲线设计。 这个盘子是慈航器的一个例子，慈航器是宋朝（960-1279）时期中国北方的一种陶瓷。
